label: GO step, agent choosing a2 again after a2->S2, early/mid episode (trials ~3-45)
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and only when the model is about to pick a2 (model_act==2; 11168/11172 active steps have action a2, choice logit strongly negative). Almost all activity follows a previous trial where a2 led to S2 by a common transition (prev_common==0 gives 1 active step), i.e. a2 stay after a2->S2. Strongly confined to episode trials ~3-45 (zero after trial 60) and to a narrow value-head band (7.73-8.10), so it looks tied to an episode-time/drift component of the hidden state. The predicate captures 99% of mass but precision is only ~0.17: within the qualifying steps the unit fires sparsely. Adding prev_reward==0 (staying with a2 after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial) raises precision to 0.38 but drops mass recall to 0.60, so unrewarded previous trials are over-represented but not required. Never fires on a1 choices, on D1/D2 steps, after rare transitions, or late in the episode. Uses only observed variables plus the agent own upcoming choice.
